_comment: Camera Raw Filter recipe for _52_9956-Pano (final v2, Nov 15 2026 PM - 8 corrections): Bryce amphitheater pano (19700x7732, cylindrical, 47mm), fog swallowing the hoodoo field from the right, window fin upper-left. Smart object = the pano DNG (raw WB editable by double-click); raw-level LrC settings incl. Glow 41/warmth +23. Saved as /Volumes/Photos2/root/2026/2026-11-01/_52_9956-Pano-Edit.tif.

WB checked first: densest fog a*+1.2/b*+2.0 (neutral-warm, ~1h before sunset); plateau gap b* -2.4 (cool distance); mid-density fog a*+5/b*+4.6 at rock hue = scatter from red rock, NOT a cast -> global WB left alone.
Crop E 2.4:1 non-destructive: x 0-17139, y 0-7141 (removes rim rubble + dead right strip). Gradient/radial coords in the UNCROPPED SO frame.

Fog glow: Radial on right fog mass INTERSECT Luminance Range 0.40/0.50/0.85/0.95; Exp +0.10, Sat -0.15, Tint -0.15. Fog 57.8 -> 63.6 L*, a* 5.0 -> 3.7 (Sat alone removed yellow, left magenta; Tint needed).

Hub light: Radial on dense hoodoo hub INTERSECT Luminance Range 0.05/0.12/0.60/0.80 (skips crevices); Exp +0.17, Sat +0.05. Lit faces +6.5..+8 L* total, crevices 0, local contrast +21%. 0.07 gave only +0.7 L* (dark subject).
Foreground haze: bottom gradient INTERSECT fade-right; Dehaze +0.25, Clarity +0.15. BL 25.9 -> 22.6 L*, detail +23%; real drifting fog kept (0.10/0.08 too weak).

Fog rock edges (PM): Fade-left gradient (zero x=0.37, full x=0.48 SO; spares hub) INTERSECT Luminance Range 0.05/0.12/0.48/0.60 (rock L* 9-54 vs fog 55-93 in the fog zone); Texture +0.25, Clarity +0.15. Rock detail right-mid +39%, bottom-right +20%, fog untouched. 0.15/0.10 was invisible at preview scale.
Crevice lift (PM): Radial on hub cluster INTERSECT Luminance Range 0/0/0.08/0.16 (darks only); Shadows +0.20, Blacks +0.10. p1 2.0->3.6, <L*6 7%->2.9%, mids/lit faces dL 0.0, local contrast -10%.

DEAD END: lifting the trees in the hub crevices. Full-res data exists (1700 16-bit levels <L*6) but under fog the trees share L* and hue (~45 deg, red-rock scatter) with shaded hoodoo faces; range 0.12/0.22 + Exp +0.25 turned shaded rock orange (+9 L*) and noisy; Tint -0.12 did not make them green. User confirmed manually. Keep the gentle lift only.

Right edge (PM): linear gradient zero x=0.674 -> full x=0.87 (crop edge); Exp -0.06. Right-edge fog 66.4->61.2 L* (flat vs interior 61.5; top 82->78); left/right mid-band gap 28->23. First try Exp -0.12 + Dehaze +0.04 overshot (-10 L*, edge darker than interior = grey band).

Window fin (PM): Radial on fin INTERSECT Luminance Range 0.05/0.12/0.50/0.62 (keeps surrounding fog L* 83 out); Clarity +0.20, Texture +0.20, Dehaze +0.15. Detail +15%, weight 0.11->0.14, fog untouched. 0.12/0.12/0.08 gave only +8%.

BR calm (PM): bottom gradient (y 0.665->0.924) INTERSECT fade-in-right (x 0.479->0.653); Exp -0.06, Sat -0.08. Bottom-right L* 23.2->21.8, C* 19.4->17.8, weight 0.34->0.31 (hub stays the 0.47 peak). Offsets the weight Fog rock edges added.
User Glow on the filter: $GLWA 28 / $GLWR 62 / $GLWS 53 / $GLWW 0 / $GLST 1 / $GLWD 0 / $GLSF 50 -> top fog +4 L*, rock unchanged. Must be resent on every scripted set.

Remove (user, Generative/firefly): pale foreground spine at bottom right. Stored in $Rtch (crs:RemoveAreas); generated pixels in binary $BigT (not in this JSON). Scripted set WITHOUT $BigT but WITH $Rtch kept the patch (verified: median dL 0.00).
8-correction set with $Rtch (~27 KB) on this 152 MP pano timed out the MCP call about half the time while still succeeding; verify with a render, never blind-retry.
To reuse on a new image: drop $Rtch (patch digests are image-specific), re-derive masks; Glow keys optional.
